master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. IMAGE1 is the authoritative full canvas geometry. IMAGE2 is the approved painting STYLE ONLY. Create Level03 ancient forest 2D platformer environment, 2048x768 wide 8:3. Trace the positions and proportions of ALL GREEN terrain and BEIGE horizontal fixed slabs in image1. Keep its sky padding above the blueprint, do not crop/zoom or shift the terrain upward. Terrain is bottom aligned. Keep the large separate holes completely open down to the bottom edge: NEVER add a continuous bottom floor. Red spikes are removed but their pits remain empty. Cyan and purple dashed rectangles are RESERVED EMPTY space: no box, no elevator, no guide cables.
There are four disconnected terrain groups: low left start bank; narrow second pier with a lower step on its right and a wider cap at top; short isolated low central island under the empty purple zone; large right bank with small left overhanging cap and high exit. There are two additional elevated isolated fixed slabs, one short at 38-47% width, one long and highest at 53-68% width. Their x/y and widths must match image1. Do not connect islands or add stairs. The very high floating long slab above the reserved elevator area can have tiny angled wooden braces attached only to its underside, no supporting column through the empty interactive zone. Small empty mossy stone exit arch follows the yellow marker on right bank, no door/seal.
Distinct scenery: immensely tall ancient cedar trunks in a deep wooded gorge, layered teal conifers, a narrow DRY vertical rock channel in the distant center background and a distant half-collapsed arch at left. Premium detailed hand-painted illustration like image2, emerald mossy stone masonry, natural cracked rock, tiny ferns and flowers, warm sunlit thin grass platform tops. Less large background architecture than image2; favor soaring tree trunks and forest depth. A little canopy foliage in top corners can frame sky without covering platforms. No painted water/waterfalls, no mist sprites, particles or long hanging vines (separate animations later). No words, grid, arrows, numbers, UI, characters, hazards, movable blocks, plates, levers, machinery or magic. Flat 2D side elevation, no perspective distortion/isometric/3D/pixel art. Geometry has priority over prettification.
static:
Use case: background-extraction. Extract the exact near gameplay environment from this master image onto REAL transparent alpha. Preserve canvas 2048x768, framing, all object positions and sizes exactly. Keep ALL sunlit grassy platforms, ground, stone columns, cliffs, timber braces, right empty stone arch, moss/ferns attached to them, and ONLY the near corner framing tree branches/leaves. Remove ALL distant blue/teal forest, sky, distant ruins/aqueduct, distant mountains and haze, leaving genuine alpha in every gap, pit, below floating bridges, and inside the empty exit arch. Do not redesign or shift anything, do not add structure, do not fill pits. Keep the sunlit thin platform tops exactly. No water, text, characters, grid, effects. Transparent PNG cutout at the same very wide 8:3 ratio, no contact sheet, no shadow backdrop.
Remove any thin beige/white blueprint border along the very bottom edge in gaps. All three deep gaps stay entirely transparent down to the image boundary. Keep four separated terrain groups and all four horizontal fixed cap slabs exactly as shown.
background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean BACKGROUND PLATE from this exact master composition. Keep the same 2048x768 wide canvas and distant forest/canopy, sky, mountains, turquoise atmosphere and distant ruins placement and brushwork. Erase ALL sharp sunlit foreground gameplay masonry, every ground bank/platform/column/bridge/exit arch and foreground ferns; reconstruct the distant forest seamlessly behind their former positions. Also remove near corner framing branches/tree trunk. The resulting image has only distant non-walkable soft painted forest and ancient atmospheric ruins. No horizontal foreground walkable ground, no readable platforms anywhere. DRY scenery: no waterfall or water streams, no mist sprite effects, no floating particles, no hanging foreground vines. No UI, grid, text, characters or mechanisms. This is inpainting the same scene, not a new composition.
